data.one_liner: Apple Liquid Glass iOS platform views for Flutter using native UIKit components.
data.what_it_does: Brings native Apple Liquid Glass controls (such as tab bars, navigation bars, buttons, and switches) into Flutter using real UIKit platform views. It gives apps the exact material, motion, and behavior shipped by Apple rather than imitating them via shaders.
use_when: Building iOS 26+ apps that require authentic native system glass components.
Needing native iOS accessibility, Dynamic Type, and haptic behaviors out of the box.
avoid_when: Supporting older versions of iOS where Liquid Glass isn't available.
Needing the same glass widgets to render on Android, web, or desktop platforms (where they render an empty SizedBox).
strengths: Uses real system UIKit views ensuring pixel-accurate Apple design and automatic point-release updates.
Supports native accessibility, VoiceOver, and behavior without manual re-implementation.
weaknesses: Platform views have a compositing cost and are unsuitable for repeating inside long list rows.
Renders an empty SizedBox on non-iOS platforms.
data.setup_notes: No native setup steps required. Works with CocoaPods and Swift Package Manager.

alternatives.name: cupertino_ui
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want pure Flutter-rendered Cupertino widgets instead of native UIKit platform views.

data.minimal_example:
LiquidGlassTabBar(
  items: const [
    LiquidGlassTabItem(label: 'Feed', icon: NativeLiquidGlassIcon.sfSymbol('house')),
    LiquidGlassTabItem(label: 'Search', icon: NativeLiquidGlassIcon.sfSymbol('magnifyingglass')),
  ],
  currentIndex: 0,
  onTabSelected: (i) {},
)
